# NPC Enchanter Enhanced 🧙‍♂️✨

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![Platform: AzerothCore](https://img.shields.io/badge/AzerothCore-C++17-blue.svg)](https://www.azerothcore.org/)
[![Module Status: Active](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Active-success.svg)]()

**NPC Enchanter Enhanced** is a feature-rich C++ module for [AzerothCore](https://www.azerothcore.org/) that revolutionizes the in-game enchanting experience. Designed for seamless integration and ease of use, it allows players to apply enchants directly through an intuitive NPC interface, supporting custom rules, flexible item requirements, and modern quality-of-life enhancements.

---

## 🚀 Key Features

* **Intuitive UI:** Clean gossip menu layout for quick navigation through weapon, armor, and stat enchants.
* **Flexible Cost System:** Configurable material requirements, gold costs, or custom token currencies.
* **Smart Filtering:** Automatically sorts available enchants based on player level, class, or profession skill.
* **Enhanced Performance:** Built using modern C++17 standards optimized for high-performance AzerothCore servers.
* **Fully Configurable:** Fine-tune pricing, restrictions, and enabled features directly from your server configuration files.

---
